**Left in Unapplied Cash — $3,000.00 (flagged as EXC-001)**

Evergreen Bank NA ACH credit on 3/23 (JE-00291 / BT-US-0081). There's no remittance advice, and Evergreen has no open invoices — their Jan/Feb/Mar subscription invoices (INV-2104/2109/2114, $6,200 each) are all already paid. $3,000 doesn't match any invoice or partial balance, so I didn't guess. It's most likely a prepayment, a duplicate/erroneous payment, or payment for something not yet billed. AR should ask Evergreen for remittance detail before it's applied or refunded.

2950 (US) now sits at $3,000 credit, down from $26,325.50. UK and DE had nothing in Unapplied Cash for March.

Two things I noticed but didn't touch since they're bank-rec rather than cash-application items: bank line BT-US-0077 (the Evergreen INV-2114 deposit) is still unmatched even though the ledger receipt JE-00280 exists, and the four original bank-feed deposit entries have no support attached themselves — the remittances are now on the application entries.
